title: Design System: Klára & Matěj, svatební oznámení

display.purpose: The couple's names on the front panel, Bodoni Moda italic; always the largest type on the page.

headline.purpose: One per panel, Bodoni Moda roman, at most one italic accent word.

title.purpose: FAQ questions, form legends, stub question, day headings, column and insert heads.

formula.purpose: The announcement sentence beneath the names.

caps.purpose: Single short uppercase lines: date, place, day labels, back meta. Tracking 0.1em at 520px and below.

numeral.purpose: Programme times with lining tabular figures; key items 1.5rem.

stamp.purpose: The "Odesláno" rubber stamp; date beneath at 0.72rem.

body.purpose: All reading text in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next at 18px; measure 36-58ch per element.

hint.purpose: Field hints and "nepovinné" in Hint Ink; errors same size at 700 in Correction Red.

button.purpose: Send button label; other buttons 1-1.125rem at the same weight.

shadows.name: card-on-envelope
shadows.purpose: The card sheet lying on the envelope.

shadows.name: insert-card
shadows.purpose: The loose insert tucked into the fold.

shadows.name: bar-stuck
shadows.purpose: Sticky bar once the card scrolls under it.

shadows.name: send-bevel
shadows.purpose: Hairline press edge on the solid-ink send button; not a lift.

shadows.name: focus-ring-fill-in
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on fill-in boxes (paper gap plus ink ring).

shadows.name: fold-crease
shadows.purpose: Background valley plus highlight at the top of every panel after the first.

shadows.name: letterpress-text
shadows.purpose: text-shadow on large Bodoni (headlines, names, back names, stub question).

shadows.name: blind-emboss-text
shadows.purpose: text-shadow on the paper-coloured K&M monogram only.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Send, bar reply, code button, add guest on :active.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.purpose: Bar background and shadow when it becomes stuck.

motion.name: faq-icon
motion.purpose: Plus turns into a cross when a FAQ row opens.

motion.name: settle-in
motion.purpose: FAQ answer on open (motion allowed only).

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Conditional section and added guests (motion allowed only).

motion.name: send-arrow
motion.purpose: Send arrow on hover, fine pointers only.

motion.name: tear-off
motion.value: WAAPI 640ms cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1), origin 14% 0: 0% none -> 22% translateY(6px) rotate(-0.8deg) -> 100% translateY(72px) rotate(2.6deg) opacity 0 blur(2px)
motion.purpose: The reply slip tears away on successful send. Reduced motion: 160ms opacity fade.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.value: WAAPI 280ms delay 60ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1): rotate(-7deg) scale(1.45) opacity 0 -> 70% scale(0.97) opacity 0.92 -> scale(1) opacity 0.88
motion.purpose: The Odesláno stamp lands. Reduced motion: 160ms opacity 0 -> 0.88.

textures.name: cotton
textures.application: Tiled 320px over paper, paper-fold (under crease gradients) and paper-insert.

textures.name: stamp-ink
textures.application: mask-image stretched 100% 100% over the stamp for uneven ink.

narrative.overview:
The site is a printed Czech wedding announcement (svatební oznámení) unfolded into one long leporello card. A single sheet of bright cotton card stock lies on a deep rosemary-green envelope, and everything on it is printed in one ink, the same green. Panels are divided by fold creases, photographs are tipped-in prints held by photo corners, the hotel code is a loose insert card, the weekend is a printed programme with dotted leaders, and the RSVP is a perforated reply slip (odpovědní lístek) that tears off and gets rubber-stamped "Odesláno". Every device on the page has to exist on a real piece of stationery; if it couldn't be printed, folded, tipped in, torn or stamped, it doesn't belong.

The density is a letter's, not an app's. One centred column (46rem) carries everything, with generous panel padding and 18px reading text for older guests on phones. Engraved Didone type (Bodoni Moda) carries the announcement voice: names, headings, the formula, spaced-caps dates, times and the stamp. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next carries everything a guest reads at length, taps or types. Controls are printed reply-card boxes and fill-in boxes: an empty box is a printed outline, a chosen box is filled with ink.

Motion behaves like ink on paper: quick ease-out presses and ticks, one deliberate tear, nothing that loops. Night mode dims the stock and deepens the envelope, but the card always stays paper. The world rejects the wedding-template stack (full-bleed couple photo hero, script-font names, countdown, grids of detail cards).
keyCharacteristics: One ink (rosemary green) on cotton stock, laid on an envelope of the same green.
Didone engraving for the announcement voice, a hyperlegible sans for reading and replying.
Stationery components only: fold creases, perforation, tick boxes, fill-in boxes, tipped-in prints, insert card, dotted leaders, rubber stamp.
Real paper physics for depth: soft drop shadows only where paper lies on paper.
Ink-on-paper motion: ticks draw in 200ms, presses scale to 0.97, one 640ms tear-off, a 280ms stamp press.
Large text, 44px targets, full meaning with no hover or motion.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Everything printed is Rosemary Ink or a transparency of it. There is no second accent, no gold and no blush. Correction Red appears only when something is wrong.

rules.name: The Paper Stays Paper Rule
rules.body: Night mode dims the stock and deepens the envelope. It never inverts the card into light-on-dark, because an announcement is paper at any hour.

rules.name: The Hint Floor Rule
rules.body: Hint Ink sits only on Cotton Stock or Folded Stock. On the Sage Insert it drops to 4.4:1, so insert copy uses Secondary Ink.

rules.name: The Engraver and the Reader Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda speaks for the couple: names, headings, formula, spaced caps, times, monogram and stamp. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next serves the guest: every paragraph, label, hint, error, button and form value. Bodoni never sets a paragraph or a form field, and never goes below 0.72rem (the stamp date only).

rules.name: The Short Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is only for single short lines in spaced Bodoni caps (a date, a place, a day label, the stamp). It never wraps past two lines and never applies to Atkinson.

rules.name: The Letterpress Rule
rules.body: Large Bodoni (headlines, names, back names, the stub question) carries a two-edge text shadow (`0 1px 0` white at 75%, `0 -0.5px 0` ink at 18%) so the type reads as pressed into the stock. Small type never gets it.

rules.name: The Paper Physics Rule
rules.body: Only paper resting on paper casts a shadow: the card on the envelope, a print or insert on the card. Printed controls never lift, never glow, and never gain a shadow on hover.

rules.name: The Light, Not Lines Rule
rules.body: Folds and the monogram are drawn with highlight and shade gradients, never with a border or a hard rule.

rules.name: The Paper Corner Rule
rules.body: Paper 3px, printed boxes 2px, controls 4px, stamp 6px. Circles exist only as perforation holes and edge notches. Nothing is ever a pill.

dos: Do print everything in Rosemary Ink or its washes and rules on Cotton, Folded or Sage stock, and keep Correction Red for errors only.
Do alternate Cotton Stock and Folded Stock panel by panel, and open every panel after the first with the fold-crease valley.

Do set the couple's voice in Bodoni Moda (names in italic as the largest type, headings in roman with at most one italic word, dates and places in spaced caps) and everything a guest reads, taps or types in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next at 1.125rem or larger for body.
Do build controls as printed stationery: 1.5px ink outlines, 2px corners, empty means outline and chosen means ink fill.
Do mount photographs as tipped-in prints with a white border, envelope-green photo corners and a slight rotation (within about ±2.5deg).
Do set times as tabular Bodoni numerals with dotted leaders running to the event name.
Do tie every single-letter preposition or conjunction to the next word with a non-breaking space, write dates as `12. června 2027`, and use Czech three-form plurals.
Do keep every target at least 44px, gate hover to fine pointers, and give every motion a reduced-motion path that is opacity-only and 160ms or shorter.
Do keep motion to ease-out presses and ticks of 280ms or less, with the 640ms tear as the only long movement.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour, gradient fills, or tinted section backgrounds beyond the three stocks.
Don't invert the card in night mode. Only dim the stock and deepen the envelope.
Don't set paragraphs, labels, hints or form values in Bodoni, or Atkinson in uppercase.
Don't use uppercase for anything longer than a short spaced-caps line.
Don't give printed controls shadows, glows or lift on hover. Shadows belong only to paper resting on paper.
Don't round anything into a pill, and don't exceed 4px on controls (the 6px stamp is the only exception).
Don't put Hint Ink on the Sage Insert.
Don't add looping, scroll-triggered or parallax motion.
Don't reach for the wedding-template stack: a full-bleed couple photo hero, script-font names, a countdown, or grids of detail cards.
Don't add small-caps kicker or eyebrow labels above headings. Each panel opens on its Bodoni headline.
